_comment: All dimensions in mm. Fancy pen holder — base tray + lid.

lid._comment: Lid shares body width/depth/fillet. Only height differs.

_pen_slots_comment: Origin (0,0) is the bottom-left corner of the body footprint viewed from above. X = left-to-right (width), Y = bottom-to-top (depth). Horizontal slots run along +X, vertical slots run along +Y. Cylinder center sits at the top surface (Z = body height).
